protocol.source_configuration: each original record retains its predeclared configuration and numerical environment
protocol.scope: read-only summaries of stored measurements; no benchmark timing rerun

resource_persistence.timing_scope: CPU CSR input through CPU residual verification and per-call cleanup; explicit barriers itemized; reference/restriction/runtime/session costs separate
resource_persistence.aggregation: median-total measured repetition per instance, not a repeated complete sequence
resource_persistence.resource_policy: persistent Config/Resources; matrix, vectors, solver and hierarchy recreated per inactive system

preparation_inclusive.preparation_scope: calibration plus independently measured median child-process startup/shutdown, including imports; GPU runtime initialization/finalization counted once

configuration.scope: manufactured solutions and prescribed plane mask; no optimization claim
configuration.timing_scope: construction through independent CPU verification and cleanup; initialization separately

rank_memory.timing_interpretation: single runs in ascending grid/rank order; first-use costs and problem-size effects are combined

configuration.transfer: zero extension of retained previous-system Ritz directions; restrict to current inactive set
configuration.rank_matching: both start at rank zero; later use min(20, transferred history rank)
configuration.timing_scope: kernel, transfer and next-space selection costs; reference construction once; calibration and mask generation separately

last_window_recycling.policy: only last 100 new search directions; existing coarse vectors excluded; unscaled Ritz
